denial.payer_remark: Non-covered service. Documentation does not show 6 weeks of conservative therapy.

visit_note.text:
Date of encounter: 2026-05-12
Orthopedic re-evaluation for persistent right knee pain.
Initial therapy commenced on 2026-03-16 with supervised PT (completed 12 sessions ending 2026-05-04) alongside prescribed naproxen 500mg BID.
Symptoms persist with weight-bearing pain and functional limitation.
Plan: Right knee MRI without contrast ordered.
Clinician: treating orthopaedic surgeon.

expected.rationale: TESS-COV-2.1 supports a knee MRI for knee pain that persists after at least 6 weeks of conservative treatment. Treatment began on 2026-03-16 and the visit was on 2026-05-12, 57 days later, with physical therapy and naproxen both documented and pain persisting. The note never states the duration; it follows from the dates.
